verdict.rationale: Founder equity guidance is a fair question for a law firm that advises start-ups, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack covers vesting schedules, 83(b) or Indian-equivalent elections, or co-founder equity splits. The employment page explicitly has no ESOP-specific material, and general statements about advising start-ups or standardizing key documents do not address founder equity mechanics.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
